sources.title: Türkiye: Draft Law Threatens LGBT People with Prison | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch article (29 Oct 2025): a leaked draft omnibus justice reform ('11th Judicial Package') would enable criminal charges against LGBT people in Türkiye — described by HRW as one of the most alarming rollbacks of rights in decades; Istanbul activists held a press conference against it (28 Oct 2025). National-level: applies countrywide if adopted, no province-specific provisions.

Kaos GL Association piece on its LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025 ('The Year of the Family: A Major Siege Against LGBTI+ People'): documents that in 2025 anti-LGBTI+ policy became institutionalized - hate speech by senior officials and instructions to public institutions under the 'Year of the Family' banner created a climate encouraging human-rights violations. National-level monitoring (media and complaint reports since 2007), no province breakdowns.
